note: This paper (J. Elementology 21(2):373-381) reports microelement CONCENTRATIONS (Zn, Cu, Fe, Mn in mg/kg DM) in two grass species treated with Kelpak SL, NOT dry matter yield. The paper does not contain yield/biomass production data suitable for the Li 2022 biostimulant/yield meta-analysis. A companion paper by the same authors (Ciepiela & Godlewska 2016, Agrochimica 59(2):124-135) reports yield and protein data. The previous agent extraction may have referenced that companion paper.
title: Effect of the biostimulant Kelpak SL on the content of some microelements in two grass species
species: Dactylis glomerata L. cv. Amila, Festulolium braunii (K.Richt.) A. Camus cv. Felopa
exclusion_reason: Paper reports microelement concentrations (Zn, Cu, Fe, Mn) not yield/biomass. No yield data in this PDF.
